# GitHub Repository About Section

This file contains the recommended description and topics for the GitHub repository's "About" section.

## How to Add This Information

1. Go to your repository on GitHub: https://github.com/0zturkSamet/shadowing-app
2. Click the ⚙️ (gear icon) next to "About" on the right sidebar
3. Copy and paste the information below

---

## Repository Description

```
A modern full-stack language learning app using YouTube videos and AI-powered transcription. Practice shadowing technique with synchronized transcripts, progress tracking, and intelligent caching. Built with Next.js, FastAPI, and OpenAI Whisper.
```

## Website (Optional)

If you have a live demo, add the URL here. Otherwise, leave blank or use:


## Additional Settings to Consider

### Repository Features

Consider enabling these features in Settings > General:

- ✅ **Issues** - Allow users to report bugs and request features
- ✅ **Projects** - Track development progress
- ✅ **Wiki** - Create detailed documentation (optional)
- ✅ **Discussions** - Enable community discussions (optional)
- ✅ **Sponsorships** - If you want to accept sponsorships (optional)

### Social Preview Image

Upload a social preview image (recommended size: 1280x640px):
- Go to Settings > General > Social preview
- Upload your landing page screenshot or create a custom banner

---

## Quick Setup Instructions

1. Navigate to: https://github.com/0zturkSamet/shadowing-app
2. Click the ⚙️ gear icon next to "About"
3. Paste the description above
4. Add the topics listed above (just copy and paste each one)
5. Check "Releases", "Packages", and "Deployments" if applicable
6. Click "Save changes"

Done! Your repository will now have a professional About section that helps others understand your project at a glance.
